Questions

What is the median annual wage for Dental hygienists in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Dental Hygienists in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA is $133,740.

What is the hourly median for Dental hygienists in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Dental Hygienists in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA is $64.30.

How many Dental hygienists work in Seattle?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 3,500 wage-and-salary Dental Hygienists in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Dental hygienists in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 1.17. Values above 1.00 mean Dental Hygienists are more concentrated in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Dental hygienists in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Dental Hygienists in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA is $141,230.

How does Seattle's Dental hygienists median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Seattle's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($133,740) is $28,260 higher than Austin ($105,480) and $33,480 higher than Chicago ($100,260). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
